chapter: Inside the Basie rhythm section and band family
title: How new men fit in; Basie controls with a look
summary: New players such as Sweets Edison fit in; Basie keeps order without words.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Well then, so we're ready to leave the
No. [No way that we'll be leaving that yet.]
Sweets came in from Jeters-Pillars
Pillars?
He would have been in Jeter-Pillars band.
E]
Well, what -- I mean now, that -- that was a -- did that cause any stir on the band, because that was a fairly different trumpet drumming style, then, wasn't it?

Yeah. No, no, no -- I don't -- listen. As I say we -- I don't remember any -- and I'm not just saying this -- I don't remember any funny feelings between the musicians -- that comes in. Because the one that come in always seemed to fit --you know -- fit whatever was going on around. You see?

You know, I always claim that -- I don't know if it's wrong or not, -- but, you don't often get something that is the top. You know -- you don't often get a Fletcher Henderson band at it's peak, you know, or a Basie band at it's peak.
No.

And, when you do, you usually have got guys who are great guys. You know, what I always said was when you get a band that's grading into inferior thing, you get guys that don't measure up and you have trouble. But, when you have the top, you've got guys that are great guys. They're great guys, and they make a point of being people -- real people, and they live right.
Yeah. Yeah. Well, they come into a band that's like that --
That's right.
they're out of place
Then they are, you know, they are disgraced, and if they have any intentions of doing the wrong way, then they have to come back, you know --
Yeah.
You know, if they're any kind of person they would say 'Well, no, I'm not going -- this is -- it's not happening over here' --
That's it. You know, make trouble or --
And, anybody sees, anybody sees that they want to belong after they get here, you know. I think that's why we don't have any problems with the musicians.
You see, and it's always been that way.
Yeah.
I mean the guy that -- I mean human nature being what it is -- you know -- some guys can be jealous --
Oh, yeah.
-- of another
Something like that.
Yeah.
Now, if they get in there and -- yeah -- I see what you're saying --
You see? And, Basie's the main --
That's it.
Basie's the main thing that keeps everything together. Basie is the man. Because it's -- when they come in -- it's a free and easy thing. But, yet he can look at them and they know --
you know --you don't have to say nothing, just look up at him and they'll say --well -- . You know, if something's wrong they'll know it -- that he don't dig it -- just by looking at him.
Yeah.
You don't have to say one word, cause he -- that's the way he handles things.
So, there's no bad feelings or anything --
And, he wouldn't have any iron hands or anything on anybody. There's the freedom, but there's, you know, -- you still don't get too far out.
Yeah.
You know -- you just -- so it's --
Yeah. Yeah.
And, they can see what -- the men around them -- whoever -- the new person that come in -- they can see how the whole thing is laid out, and they act accordingly.
Yeah, yeah.
And, they feel easier after they find out "Well, this is happening over here. Well, this is fine."
Yeah. "Hard to believe it, but here it is."
It's a place where -- yeah -- it's a good place to be.
That's right.
